topic: How to Time Finance Around a Growth Opportunity
objective: Emphasise the importance of arranging finance ahead of, not during, a growth opportunity.

slides.headline: Timing Finance Around Growth
slides.subheadline: Arrange finance before you need it, not during.

slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: Finance applications take time to assess, which means waiting until an opportunity is already in motion can mean missing it. Arranging finance ahead of a known opportunity, or having a facility on standby, means you're ready to act the moment the timing is right.

caption:
One of the most common frustrations in business is spotting a great opportunity and then losing precious time to a finance application, because assessment simply takes time, no matter how strong the case.

The fix is sequencing: having a facility already arranged or pre-assessed, so that when the right opportunity appears, the finance side isn't the bottleneck.
